theorems: For a model-relative NAE edge the only forbidden flip-set intersections are the minority singleton and the majority pair.
A fixed escape selector plus monotone E1/E2 closure terminates after at most |V| additions.
Every closure fixed point is a valid repair mask.
There exists a protected-set-avoiding escape selector iff there exists a protected-set-avoiding valid repair mask.

active_gate.target: Poly structural synthesis of a selector whose monotone closure flips the pivot while avoiding protected canonical variables.
